services.description: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) provides scalable computing capacity in the AWS cloud. Use EC2 to launch virtual servers, configure security and networking, and manage storage.
services.description_zh: Amazon EC2提供AWS云中的可扩展计算容量。使用EC2启动虚拟服务器、配置安全和网络以及管理存储。
key_features: Multiple instance types optimized for different workloads
Auto Scaling for automatic capacity adjustment
Amazon EBS for persistent block storage

services.description: AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that runs your code in response to events and automatically manages the underlying compute resources.
services.description_zh: AWS Lambda是一种无服务器计算服务，可响应事件运行代码并自动管理底层计算资源。
key_features: Pay per request and compute time

services.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) is a fully managed container orchestration service that makes it easy to deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications.
services.description_zh: Amazon ECS是一种完全托管的容器编排服务，可轻松部署、管理和扩展容器化应用程序。
key_features: EC2 launch type for more control

services.description: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) is a managed Kubernetes service that makes it easy to run Kubernetes on AWS without needing to install and operate your own Kubernetes control plane.
services.description_zh: Amazon EKS是一种托管的Kubernetes服务，可轻松在AWS上运行Kubernetes，无需安装和操作自己的Kubernetes控制平面。

services.description: Amazon Lightsail is designed to be the easiest way to launch and manage a virtual private server with AWS. Lightsail includes everything you need to launch your project quickly.
services.description_zh: Amazon Lightsail旨在成为使用AWS启动和管理虚拟专用服务器的最简单方法。Lightsail包含快速启动项目所需的一切。
